## NECROTIZING INFECTIONS--PATHOGEN-DIRECTED THERAPY
## ________________________________________________
## Clostridial infections
## ________________________________________________
## Preferred treatment
Penicillin 4 million units IV q4h ($) [R] <AND> clindamycin 900 mg
IV q8h ($$) [H,O]
## Alternative for penicillin allergy
Clindamycin 900 mg IV q8h ($$) [H,O]
## _______________________________________________
## Group A Streptococcal infections (S. pyogenes)
## _______________________________________________
## Preferred treatment
Penicillin 4 million units IV q4h ($) [R] <AND> clindamycin 900 mg
IV q8h ($$) [H,O]
## Alternative for penicillin allergy
Clindamycin 900 mg IV q8h ($$) [H,O]
< OR >
Vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h ($) [R]
## ______________________________________________
## Polymicrobial infections
## ______________________________________________
These are more common in injection drug users, or in patients who have had
recent abdominal surgery or trauma, vulvo-vaginal infection, or genital or
rectal abscess.
## Preferred Treatment:
Piperacillin-tazobactam 3.375 gm IV q6h ($$) [R] <AND> clindamycin 900 mg
IV q8h ($$) [H,O] <AND> vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h ($) [R]
< OR >
Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q24h ($) [M] <AND> clindamycin 900 mg IV q8h
($$) [H,O] <AND> vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h ($) [R] < OR >
Meropenem 1 gm IV q8h ($$) [R] <AND> vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h ($) [R]
## Alternatives for penicillin allergy
Ciprofloxacin 400 mg IV q12h ($) [R,DI] <AND> clindamycin 900 mg IV
q8h ($$) [H,O] <AND> vancomycin 15mg/kg IV q12h ($) [R] < OR >
Gentamicin 5 mg/kg IV q24h ($) [R,O] <AND> clindamycin 900 mg IV q8h
($$) [H,O] <AND> vancomycin 15mg/kg IV q12h ($) [R]
